title: Completion of the reading routine
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input and let $c$ be a configuration with $m$ work tapes. Suppose $r$ and $s$ are distinct tape indices, tape $r$ of $c$ contains the binary representation of $i$, and its head is at position $0$. Then there is a number $T$ such that the reading program, started in its initial reading phase with tape $s$ holding the binary representation of $\min(i,|x|)$ and input-head position $\min(i,|x|)+1$, reaches the terminal state corresponding to the $i$th symbol of $x$ (or no symbol if that index is out of range), with input-head position $1$ and tape $s$'s head at position $0$. Every configuration at a time $n<T$ lies in the read frame of $c$.
